description: This file defines the NoteListAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It manages creating view holders, binding note data to views, and handling click and long-click events on note items.

classes.name: NoteListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for rendering a list of notes in a RecyclerView, including click event handling.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: Inner static class representing a view holder for individual note items.

methods.name: NoteListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the adapter with a list of notes and a click listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_note layout and creates a NoteViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds note data to the view holder and sets click listeners.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of notes and refreshes the view.
